question: Does Otto have a favorite hairstyle for girls?
answer: Otto doesn’t judge a person by how they look, like their hair. His first love was a cat. So his crush might not even be a human or might not even have hair. So he doesn’t care. In Re: Zero he might be the most indifferent towards the characters' appearances. He doesn’t judge people by their looks, he judges by how he feels when talking, so the inside. He doesn’t care about how he looks. It annoys me that he knows that he looks good. It doesn’t mean he can’t identify beauty or ugliness. He can say beautiful things are beautiful. He just doesn’t judge things based only on that. He is a merchant, so he needs to be able to identify good and bad. Though he has bad luck. That’s Otto.
